body:
Yes, this is how `@IfBuildProfile` is implemented. And programmatic lookup (`@Inject Instance<>`) does attempt to resolve ambiguous dependencies, i.e. remove non-alternative beans if an alternative is present. 

@geoand I don't remember the details but it seems that `@AlternativePriority` is added to solve some conflicts? https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/blob/master/extensions/arc/deployment/src/main/java/io/quarkus/arc/deployment/BuildTimeEnabledProcessor.java#L186

I agree that this behavior is not very user-friendly :-(.

A workaround exist, the programmatic lookup can be replaced with `BeanManager#getBeans()` plus `io.quarkus.arc.ArcContainer.instance(InjectableBean<T>)`. But it's not ideal because it does not resolve ambiguities...

> @geoand I don't remember the details but it seems that `@AlternativePriority` is added to solve some conflicts? https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/blob/master/extensions/arc/deployment/src/main/java/io/quarkus/arc/deployment/BuildTimeEnabledProcessor.java#L186

Yeah, IIRC we did it to avoid conflicts with `quarkus.arc.selected-alternatives`

I expected ambiguities to be resolved at the every specific service level. Am I wrong?
So if I have service A with implementation A1 and service B with implementations B1 and B2, and if B1 has some `@AlternativePriority` it should be chosen over B2 only and A1 should still stay. So I expect the resulting implementations to be A1 and B1.
Now ambiguities are resolved over all services and only B1 stays

>  So I expect the resulting implementations to be A1 and B1.

Yep, the problem is that in the grpc case all services implement the `BindableService`... @michalszynkiewicz Am I right?

> Yeah, IIRC we did it to avoid conflicts with quarkus.arc.selected-alternatives

@geoand I wonder if we really need to add anything for **enabled** bean...
We can certainly remove that part and see if the tests pass :)

Hm, all the tests seem to pass. I'll send a PR shortly. @manovotn WDYT?

BTW I found this: https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/8343#discussion_r403957050
